offices.title: Village Trustee
offices.org_name: Village of Wells River Board of Trustees

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 285 (Village of Wells River): sec. 6 elects three trustees on three-year staggered terms

Village of Wells River, Staff page (wellsrivervillage.org): lists the trustees -- Jean Welch (Head Trustee), Mike Thomas, and Erik White. All three signed the February 12, 2026 village warning as Trustees

offices.title: Village President
offices.org_name: Village of Wells River Village President

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 285 (Village of Wells River): sec. 6 lists the Village President among the village's elective officers, and the 2026 Warning (Art. 1) elects one for a one-year term; no official source names the current president, so the post is created without a membership

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 285 (Village of Wells River): sec. 6 elects a Village Clerk

Village of Wells River, Staff page: styles Mary Schilke 'Village Clerk, Treasurer and Tax Collector'; she recorded the 2026 village warning as Village Clerk. One person record carries all three memberships
